subject: actionButton and output in a different Panel

messages.author: 8ff2f058a2d9b51a
messages.subject: actionButton and output in a different Panel
parts:
Hi everybody,

I have an UI with a navbarPanel, where in the Panel1 I have an actionButton, but I want that the output, after several computing, appears in Panel2. Below is an example code, but my problem is that when the button is pressed there is no action until I click to the Panel2. That is, if you click the button and wait 5 seconds and then goes to Panel2 there does not appear anything until waiting 5 seconds more, so indicating that the code only runs when the tabset Panel2 is clicked. Is there any solution to run the code in the server without clicking the output Panel?


# ui.R
require(shiny)

ui <- shinyUI(
  navbarPage("Test",id="nav",
             tabPanel("Panel1",
                      textInput("num", label=h6("Input"), value="10"),
                      br(),
                      actionButton("actionClick", label="Click")
            ),
             tabPanel("Panel2",                      
                      h6("Output"),
                      textOutput("Number")        
            )
  )
)


# server.R

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
    
    output$Number<-renderText({ 
        if(input$actionClick==0){
          return()
        } else{
          Sys.sleep(5) # simulate high intensive computing
          input$num    
          
        }
})

A solution is to introduce the code below in the server.R, however I do not think that is a nice solution and also I would like to output the results in different tabsets (navlistPanel inside the navbarPage), so it is not useful.

observeEvent(input$actionClick,
{updateTabsetPanel(session,inputId="nav", selected="Panel2")
}
)

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: actionButton and output in a different Panel
parts:
You can use:
  outputOptions(output, "Number", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

See ?outputOptions for more information.

-Winston
